about: The epistola of the formulary “8th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: We are debtors, not to the flesh, so as to live according to the flesh. For if you live according to the flesh, you will die; but if by the spirit you put the deeds of the flesh to death, you will live. For all who are led by the Spirit of God, these are sons of God. For you did not receive a spirit of servitude, to be in fear once more; but you received the spirit of the adoption of sons, in which we cry out: Abba, Father. For the Spirit Himself bears witness to our spirit that we are sons of God. And if sons, then heirs as well: heirs of God, and co-heirs with Christ.
